title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1112 | 海底珊瑚城、狗狗大闹婚礼、香蕉变塑料
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

🪸 海底藏着一座长达一点五公里的“珊瑚城”，当地人叫它玫瑰珊瑚！
🐶 一只小狗突然闯进婚礼，还跑去找当戒指小管家的狗狗 Duggie 玩！
🍌 十三岁的 Rye 用香蕉做出了塑料，还拿了全国科学大奖！

📖 Word of the day: colossal（巨大的；庞大的）

🎮 二选一：潜水游进海底珊瑚城，还是让一只搞笑小狗闯进你的生日派对偷吃蛋糕？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

🪸 Scientists found a secret coral city under the sea, one and a half kilometers long — people call it the rose coral!
🐶 A little dog crashed a wedding in England and ran straight to Duggie, the ring bearer dog!
🍌 Thirteen-year-old Rye turned bananas into plastic and won a big national science prize!

📖 Word of the day: colossal

🎮 Would you rather: swim through a giant coral city under the sea, or have a funny little dog crash your birthday party and steal the cake?

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. colossal（巨大的；庞大的）
really, really big, bigger than big
例：The rose coral is colossal!（玫瑰珊瑚巨大无比！）

2. coral（珊瑚）
a tiny sea animal that builds huge reefs under the sea
例：The coral looks like a giant rose!（珊瑚看起来像一朵巨大的玫瑰！）

3. gatecrash（不请自来；闯入）
to show up at a party without being invited
例：The little dog gatecrashed the wedding!（小狗不请自来，闯进了婚礼！）

4. bioplastic（生物塑料）
plastic made from plants, not from oil
例：Rye made bioplastic from bananas!（Rye 用香蕉做出了生物塑料！）
